title: FMLA Case Study - Sarah Thompson
content: Sarah Thompson has recently applied for FMLA due to a diagnosis requiring extended treatment. The case is complex due to the nature of her role and the duration of the leave requested. Detailed documentation and discussions with her department have been conducted to ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies. This information is sensitive and should only be shared with close friends or appropriate personnel.

title: Employee Wellness Seminar Planning
content: Planning is underway for the 'Healthy Horizons' employee wellness seminar.
